content.scopeOfRegistration: The scope of the ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification is limited to the artificial intelligence management system (AIMS) supporting the development and deployment of OpenAI’s models and products - including consumer offerings (ChatGPT, Sora) and business offerings (API, ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, and Edu) - in OpenAI’s role of an AI producer, AI developer, and AI provider, and in accordance with the statement of applicability, version 1.1, dated November 8, 2025.

The Information Security Management System (ISMS) and Privacy Information Management System (PIMS) of OpenAI and its affiliate companies encompass the people, processes, and technologies used to develop, deploy, operate, and secure OpenAI products and services provided to organizations and API users. The certified scope includes the products listed in the “Product compliance status” table at https://openai.com/product-compliance-status, version 1.1, last updated August 4, 2026. It also includes OpenAI-managed features and capabilities made available as part of those products and services. The scope does not include ChatGPT Business, Beta Services, consumer services, nor does it extend to third-party platforms, applications, or systems connected to or accessed through OpenAI products and services.

This scope aligns with the control implementation guidance and additional control sets of ISO/IEC 27017:2015 and ISO/IEC 27018:2025, and also includes the PIMS requirements, control implementation guidance, and additional control set of ISO/IEC 27701:2019 in the role of a personally identifiable information (PII) processor, as outlined in the statement of applicability, version 3, dated June 10, 2026.
